title: Ridgeline Pro Credit Pricing Assurance — Price-Protection Credit on Quoted and Contract-Priced Invoices
content:
Ridgeline Pro Credit stands behind the prices it agreed. When an approved invoice dispute is for a wrong price and the disputed invoice carried an agreed price, the dispute settlement credit includes a price-protection credit.

## Rule

The price-protection rate is set by how the disputed invoice was priced, as recorded on the invoice line, together with the dispute category on the request:

| How the disputed invoice was priced | Dispute category | Price-protection rate |
|---|---|---|
| Under a ProBuild volume pricing quote | Wrong price | 10 percent |
| At a contract price fixed in an installation or special order agreement | Wrong price | 5 percent |
| Any other case — a shelf-priced invoice, or a dispute for a wrong quantity, merchandise not received or an unauthorized buyer | | Zero |

The price-protection credit is the disputed amount times the price-protection rate, divided by one hundred. It enters the dispute settlement credit unrounded; the credit is rounded to the nearest cent on its total.

## Worked cases (hypothetical, disputed amount 386.40)

- Quote-priced invoice, wrong price: 386.40 times 10, divided by one hundred, is 38.64.
- Contract-priced invoice, wrong price: 386.40 times 5, divided by one hundred, is 19.32.
- Quote-priced invoice, wrong quantity: zero.
- Shelf-priced invoice, wrong price: zero.
